gm_lines: Gain Tame.

Tame: Train one non-sapient Beast to obey commands in and out of combat. Requirements: find, purchase, rescue, raise, or capture the creature; spend 8 hours training one creature; make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The DC is 10 + the creature's Challenge Rating. Successful Check: The creature becomes Tame. Failed Check: The creature is not Tame. You may train again after addressing an appropriate narrative obstacle. You may train only one creature at a time.

Tamer Capacity: You may maintain a number of Tame Creatures no greater than your Proficiency Bonus; a total combined Challenge Rating no greater than the table. After the first CR 0 creature, treat each additional CR 0 creature as CR 1/8. If training a creature would exceed a cap, release enough Tame Creatures to remain within the limit.

Contested Control: When another creature attempts to control one of your Tame Creatures, it must first make a Charisma check opposed by your Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. Failed Opposed Check: The control attempt fails. Successful Opposed Check: Resolve the controlling effect normally.
